articles.summary: Single-family homes from the mid $200s offer up to 5 bedrooms and 2,180 square feet, with quartz countertops included and easy access to I-26 KEY TAKEAWAYS New construction homes in Clinton: Century Complete is planning 139 single-family homesites at Shell Creek Manor, with homes starting from the mid $200s. Flexible floor plans: Five single-family floor plans from 1,290 to 2,180 square feet, with 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 3 bathrooms and 2-car garages. Built-in style: Every home at Shell Creek Manor features an open-concept layout with stylish features like quartz countertops and luxury vinyl-plank flooring. Convenient location: Shell Creek Manor offers easy access to Interstate 26 and boasts efficient commutes to Spartanburg, Greenville, and Columbia. Virtual Insider Event: This 30-minute online event is planned for Monday, Nov. 9 at 5:30 p.m. Attendees will find out more about homesite releases and Grand Opening incentives.
